description:
This module addresses the critical need to monitor and log the resource consumption of Large Language Models (LLMs) during each Factory Run. As the Factory AI GMO platform expands, accurately tracking LLM usage—specifically prompt tokens, completion tokens, and the associated monetary cost—becomes essential for various purposes, including cost analysis, resource allocation, and future billing capabilities. This module extends the capabilities introduced by `factoryRun` and `factoryArtifact` by providing granular visibility into the operational expenses incurred by LLM invocations, paving the way for transparent internal accounting and potential external monetization of AI services.

BUSINESS REQUIREMENTS
- Record the number of prompt tokens used by LLMs for each Factory Run.
- Record the number of completion tokens generated by LLMs for each Factory Run.
- Record the total monetary cost in USD associated with the LLM usage for each Factory Run.
- Associate LLM usage records with a specific Factory Run.
- Enable retrieval of LLM usage data for reporting and analysis.

CONSTRAINTS
- This module (`factoryRunUsage`) belongs to the Factory AI GMO commercial platform and has no existing companyId relationship within the POS GMO retail tenant model; it must never be given a companyId.
- created_At and updated_at audit fields are server-controlled and automatically injected.
- References to `factoryRun` will be a plain string reference field (`factoryRunRef`) because `factoryRun` is a conceptual module in the Factory AI GMO platform and its table is not confirmed live in the POS GMO database, following the established pattern for modules like `organization`, `projects`, and `factoryArtifact`.

OPEN ARCHITECTURAL QUESTIONS
1. Granularity of Usage Recording: Currently, the request implies a single usage record per `factoryRun`. Should the system allow for multiple LLM usage events within a single `factoryRun` (e.g., if a run involves multiple distinct LLM calls that need individual tracking)? If so, how should these multiple events be aggregated or distinguished within `factoryRunUsage`? This decision will impact the cardinality of the relationship between `factoryRun` and `factoryRunUsage` and potentially require additional identifying fields within `factoryRunUsage`.
2. Cost Calculation Source and Precision: The cost is currently specified as `costUSD`. How will this cost be calculated? Will it be derived from internal token pricing models, or will it be directly provided by the LLM service? What level of precision (e.g., number of decimal places) is required for `costUSD`, and are there any specific rounding rules that need to be applied for billing accuracy? This will inform the data type and validation rules for the `costUSD` field.
3. Integration with External Billing Systems: While billing enforcement is out of scope for this PRD, consideration should be given to the future requirements for integrating this usage data with an external billing system. What unique identifier, if any, from `factoryRunUsage` would be required for such an integration to ensure accurate mapping and reconciliation of costs? This might influence the design of an immutable `usageEventId` or similar field.

fields.name: factoryRunRef
fields.description: Reference ID to the Factory Run that generated this LLM usage. A plain string reference as factoryRun is not yet a live table.

fields.name: promptTokens
fields.description: Number of tokens consumed by the LLM prompt for this Factory Run.

fields.name: completionTokens
fields.description: Number of tokens generated by the LLM for the completion in this Factory Run.

fields.name: totalTokens
fields.description: Total tokens (prompt + completion) consumed/generated by the LLM for this Factory Run.

fields.name: costUSD
fields.description: Total monetary cost in USD for the LLM usage during this Factory Run.

fields.name: modelName
fields.description: The name of the LLM model used (e.g., 'gemini-pro').

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: The timestamp when the LLM usage event was recorded.

components.name: FactoryRunUsageList
components.description: A table or list displaying all recorded LLM usage entries with columns for `factoryRunRef`, `promptTokens`, `completionTokens`, `totalTokens`, `costUSD`, `modelName`, and `timestamp`.

components.name: FactoryRunUsageDetail
components.description: A detailed view for a single LLM usage entry, showing all fields.

endpoints.description: Records a new LLM usage entry for a Factory Run.
Retrieves a single LLM usage entry by its ID.
